title: check-web-archive.mjs reports all_archived=true when lychee's only errors are non-HTTP links
body:
`scripts/check-web-archive.mjs` can turn a failing lychee run into a green job. Found while fixing CI in `link-foundation/link-cli` (issue link-foundation/link-cli#96), which vendors this script from the AI driven development pipeline templates.

This template already scopes parsing to the `## Errors per input` section, so the redirect false positive reported against the C# template does not apply here — but the second defect does.

## Bug B — false negative: non-HTTP lychee errors are silently reported as "all archived"

`extractBrokenUrls()` only ever returns `http(s)` URLs. lychee, however, also reports errors that have no URL to look up in the Wayback Machine:

```
### Errors in csharp/docs/index.md

* [ERROR] <file:///home/runner/work/repo/repo/csharp/docs/api/Some.Type.yml> (at 15:12) | File not found. Check if file exists and path is correct

### Errors in js/index.html

* [ERROR] <error:> (at 10:49) | Cannot resolve root-relative link '/favicon.svg': To resolve root-relative links in local files, provide a root dir
```

Those entries are dropped, so when they are the *only* errors:

```js
if (brokenUrls.length === 0) {
  console.log('No broken URLs found in lychee output.');
  setOutput('all_archived', 'true');   // <-- masks a real lychee failure
  process.exit(0);
}
```

`all_archived=true` makes the workflow's final gate

```yaml
if: steps.lychee.outputs.exit_code != 0 && steps.webarchive.outputs.all_archived != 'true'
```

skip, and the job goes green even though lychee exited non-zero with a broken link. A missing file or a broken relative link in the docs is exactly the class of error the checker exists to catch.

### Reproduction

1. Add a Markdown file containing a link to a non-existent local file, e.g. `[gone](./does-not-exist.yml)`.
2. Run the Broken Link Checker workflow.
3. lychee reports `🚫 Errors | 1` and a non-zero exit code, `check-web-archive.mjs` prints `No broken URLs found in lychee output.` and sets `all_archived=true`, and the job succeeds.

### Workaround

Fail on any lychee error whose link is not an HTTP URL, or drop the `fail: false` / Wayback fallback for local links.

### Suggested fix

Parse the status marker rather than the URL, and split the results:

```js
const entryPattern =
  /^\s*(?:\*|-)\s+\[(?:4\d\d|5\d\d|ERROR|TIMEOUT|UNKNOWN)\]\s+<?([^\s>|)]+)>?/gim;

// ... in main():
const { urls, others } = extractBrokenLinks(content);
if (others.length > 0) {
  // no Wayback equivalent exists for these -> report and fail
}
const allArchived = withoutArchive.length === 0 && others.length === 0;
```

## Reference implementation

Fixed in `link-foundation/link-cli` (issue link-foundation/link-cli#96, PR link-foundation/link-cli#97):

- `.github/scripts/check-web-archive.mjs` — section-scoped parser + `{urls, others}` split
- `.github/scripts/check-web-archive.test.mjs` — unit tests over a lychee report captured from the failing run
- `.github/scripts/fixtures/lychee-report.md` — the fixture

The templates ship no test for this script; adding one would have caught both defects.
